generation_rules: A settlement requires a causal founding/continuation reason.
Planet exists does not imply settlement exists.
Population scale constrains number and size distribution of settlements.
Infrastructure scales with technology, environment, population and political capacity.
Capital status requires political/institutional history, not largest-city assumption.
Spaceport appears only when local technology/traffic justifies it.
Colonies may fail, shrink, merge, relocate or be abandoned.
Stable districts/settlements retain identity once materialized.
